metadata.gitb:name: [x.epcis-2.0.1.document] Self-test: the publisher's examples pass, a non-document is rejected
metadata.gitb:description: Runs without interaction. Every example GS1 ships for GS1 EPCIS / CBV 2.0.1, EPCIS document (JSON Schema and SHACL) must conform, and a document that is not one must not; together they prove the hosted type discriminates and is faithful to the release.

verify.desc: A document that is not one must be REJECTED (JSON Schema)
A graph without the root class must be REJECTED (SHACL)
The publisher's example with created retyped or dropped must be REJECTED (the publisher's shapes are live)

success.default: "The x.epcis-2.0.1.document type accepts the publisher's examples and rejects a non-document."

failure.default: "Self-test failed: the hosted x.epcis-2.0.1.document type does not say what release 2.0.1 says."
